meta.name: Android apps (Waydroid) demo
meta.author: you
meta.description: Run Android apps on the desktop via Waydroid — the 'android stratum' (docs/strata-design.md §13). A container on the host kernel, not a chroot or VM; apps launch from fuzzel/rofi. Hardware-gated: needs binderfs in the kernel and a real GPU. `system: GAPPS` pulls Play services (many apps need it); use VANILLA/FOSS otherwise. Apps install on the first graphical session; `android-install <apk|fdroid-id>` adds more anytime.
